question: Quanto faturamos com a venda de itens do segmento de informatica_acessorios em compras finalizadas?
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    p.category_name_pt, 
    ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS category_revenue 
FROM marts.fct_order_items oi 
JOIN marts.dim_products p 
    ON oi.product_id = p.product_id 
WHERE oi.is_delivered = TRUE 
  AND p.category_name_pt = 'informatica_acessorios' 
GROUP BY p.category_name_pt;
